Release request-scoped account affinity after incomplete or stalled tools, preserve per-tool gap evidence, and add bounded single-request field-size probes. Keep partial tool JSON unexecuted and preserve configured timeout and output budgets.
工具截断或停滞后解除当前请求的账号亲和绑定，补充参数空闲位置指标与单请求诊断探针；不执行半截工具、不增加隐式超时或字节硬限制。
